content: The chapter says Ibn Turka cultivated Ulugh Beg's patronage by dedicating an important lettrist work to him and declaring the Samarkand Observatory the realisation of his own hopes; that Qāżīzāda Rūmī (d. ca. 835/1432), second director of the observatory, was a friend of Ibn Turka from childhood; and that Ibn Turka completed the Mafāḥiṣ in 1420, the year observatory construction began.
